Text Case Converter

Type once and get your text in every case at the same time — camel, Pascal, snake, kebab, constant, title, sentence and more.

Runs on your device Works offline
Every case, live Click to copy

Smart splitting

Words are detected from spaces, punctuation, snake_case, kebab-case and camelCase boundaries — so you can paste an identifier in one style and get every other style back.

How it works

  1. 1Type onceAny phrase or variable name.
  2. 2See every casecamelCase, snake_case, Title Case and more.
  3. 3Tap to copyThe one you need.

Naming conventions, decoded

camelCase is the norm for JavaScript and Java variables, PascalCase for classes and React components, snake_case for Python and SQL, kebab-case for URLs and CSS classes, and CONSTANT_CASE for environment variables and constants.
